name: Renishaw
description: Renishaw plc is an engineering and precision metrology company founded in 1973 in Wotton-under-Edge, Gloucestershire, United Kingdom. Its neurological division manufactures the [neuromate](/robot/renishaw_neuromate) stereotactic neurosurgical robot for deep brain stimulation (DBS), stereoelectroencephalography (SEEG), and neuroendoscopy.
